title: Figure 24: Monthly Distribution of Astronomical vs. All Other Object Sightings
description: Back-to-back horizontal bar chart comparing the monthly distribution, January through December, of "Total Less Astronomical" object sightings (left) with sightings evaluated as "Astronomical" (right), both in percent from 0 to 40. July and August show the longest bars on both sides. Caption: "FIGURE 24 COMPARISON OF MONTHLY DISTRIBUTION OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS EVALUATED AS ASTRONOMICAL VERSUS TOTAL OBJECT SIGHTINGS LESS ASTRONOMICAL"; drawing A-7502.
